name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal layer — a centred panel over a scrim. Consumes the layer family through createLayerParts; declares only Root, Trigger, Portal and the centring transform. Title renders Text.Heading as="h2" through render; Description renders Text.Paragraph. The close affordance is Clickable.Button variant="icon" shape="square" size="sm" with an sr-only label, positioned with logical properties.
